heroHeadline: Day 600: Sheinbaum Condemns Israeli Flotilla Interception as 'Unjustifiable Aggression'; Guerrero Peace Dialogue Installed; USMCA Round Opens Week of May 25
heroSubtitle: May 24, 2026 marks Day 600 of Claudia Sheinbaum's presidency. On Day 599 (Saturday, May 23), Sheinbaum condemned Israel's interception of the Gaza-bound Global Sumud Flotilla in international waters as 'una agresión injustificable' — three Mexican women were among those detained by Israeli forces before being released to Istanbul. She also publicly questioned the Chihuahua-Texas bilateral security agreement as a potential sovereignty violation ('está raro'), linking it to the CIA-Chihuahua incident that has been under federal probe since April 23. Also on May 23: the federal government formally installed the Mesa de Diálogo por la Paz for the Chilapa-Hueycantenango corridor in Guerrero's Montaña Baja, appointing ten new municipal commissioners as community-government liaisons following the Los Ardillos/Los Tlacos displacement crisis of over 800 indigenous families. Sheinbaum also conducted a working visit to Morelos, which coincided with a Tlaltizapán armed attack leaving six dead. Looking ahead: the first formal bilateral USMCA negotiating round opens the week of May 25, directly following the landmark 8th EU-Mexico Summit (May 22) where Sheinbaum, EU Council President Costa, and Commission President von der Leyen signed the Modernised Global Agreement and Interim Trade Agreement. U.S. envoys are expected in Mexico City around May 27. Drug czar Sara Carter's visit has been rescheduled to June 2026. Annual inflation decelerated to 4.11% in the first fortnight of May (down from 4.45% full April) — first continued deceleration of 2026.
